card.name: End of Arabic names with Allah
card.fires_on: The closing piece of Arabic or Islamic names and phrases that end in -allah, such as Najibullah, Abdallah, Mashallah and Rasulullah. It fires on the last piece (allah, ullah, ah) after a name stem.

modes.label: Names ending in -ullah/-allah
modes.description: Personal names where a stem like Najib or Abd is completed by ullah or allah.

modes.label: Religious phrases ending in -ah
modes.description: The final syllable of Arabic religious phrases or titles such as Rasulullah or Bismillah.

card.plain: It marks the point where an Arabic name or phrase containing Allah is finished.
